title: MT82 external controls: component locations
introduction:
This reference locates the external gearshift controls for the MT82 six-speed manual transmission. I read the drawing from the driver’s hand toward the gearbox: start at the knob, look below it to the boot, then follow the lever assembly and its visible connections toward the transmission. It gives the familiar cabin shifter some useful below-the-console context.

Match each circled callout to the Item column, then read across to Description. The leader line identifies the component being named; nearby links and supports provide location context rather than additional labeled parts. The Part Number column supplies no ordering identifiers.

Think of this as a street map for the shifter. It helps identify what you are looking at before choosing the matching service information. It does not specify removal order, adjustment, fastener torque or a diagnostic test, and it cannot establish why a shift feels difficult.

edits.why: Use the circled callouts and table together to distinguish the driver-contact parts from the lever assembly shown beside the gearbox. The illustration establishes component location; it does not authorize disassembly or adjustment.
